CardDescription.zh:
生长在松木林隙中；需要高酸度、低到中等养分和低到中等湿度。

有助于健康，同时减少呼吸道感染和压力。
CardDescription.en:
Found in pine clearings; needs high acidity, low to mid nutrients, and low to mid hydration.

Boosts wellbeing, while reducing respiratory infections and stress.
CardDescription.ja:
松の平地で見つけられる。酸度（高）、水分（低～中）、栄養（低～中）で育つ。

幸福度をブーストし、呼吸器感染とストレスを抑える。

CardHelpSection.zh: 产地：松木林隙，夏季盛开。 需求：高等酸度，低到中等湿度，低到中等养分。 效果：蜜源、动物饲料、覆土作物。（花：温和的兴奋剂、祛痰药）
CardHelpSection.en: Found: Pine Clearings. Blooms in Summer. Growth Needs: High Acidity, Low to Mid Hydration, Low to Mid Nutrients. Benefits: Nectariferous, Animal Feed, Cover Crop, (Flowers: Mild Stimulant, Expectorant)
CardHelpSection.ja: 発見： 松林の中の空き地。 Blooms in Summer. Growth Needs: High Acidity, Low to Mid Hydration, Low to Mid Nutrients. Benefits: Nectariferous, Animal Feed, Cover Crop, (Flowers: Mild Stimulant, Expectorant)
